insight.headline: Access app logs in Shopify CLI
insight.what_changed: Shopify CLI version 5.1 adds the shopify app logs command, which lists your app’s recent logs in your terminal. It returns the same logs you see in the Dev Dashboard, such as webhook deliveries, Admin API requests, and Shopify Function runs. This is an optional new command and doesn’t require changes to existing apps. What changed shopify app logs returns historical log records for one app, then e…
